news.q: How many seconds did Junior Caminero's pennant-clinching home run trot take, to the nearest second?
A new Penn State study found how many minutes of daily strength training improved mobility in older adults?
news.fact: It improved both mobility and everyday physical function.

easy.q: In what year did the Wright brothers make the first powered airplane flight?
easy.fact: Orville's first hop at Kitty Hawk lasted 12 seconds and covered 120 feet.

easy.q: In what year did the first iPhone go on sale?
easy.fact: Steve Jobs unveiled it in January, and it hit stores on June 29.

easy.q: How many U.S. states touch Lake Michigan?
easy.fact: It's the only Great Lake entirely inside the U.S.

easy.q: How many players per team are on a basketball court?
easy.fact: James Naismith's first game, in 1891, used peach baskets.

easy.q: In what year did World War I end?
easy.fact: The armistice took effect at 11 a.m. on November 11.

medium.q: In what year was the Cuban Missile Crisis?
medium.fact: The standoff lasted 13 days in October.

medium.q: In what year did MTV go on the air?
medium.fact: The first video it played was 'Video Killed the Radio Star.'

medium.q: How tall is One World Trade Center, in feet?
medium.fact: The height nods to the year of the Declaration of Independence.

medium.q: In what year was the Miracle on Ice?
medium.fact: U.S. college players beat the Soviets 4–3 at Lake Placid.

medium.q: In what year did Lincoln give the Gettysburg Address?
medium.fact: The speech ran about 270 words and took around two minutes.

hard.q: In what year was the Statue of Liberty dedicated?
hard.fact: France gave it to the United States. It was dedicated on October 28, 1886.

hard.q: In what year did McDonald's first hand out Halloween pails, now called Boo Buckets?
hard.fact: They came back in October 2026 themed to five Disney villains.

hard.q: How many feet below sea level is Badwater Basin in Death Valley?
hard.fact: It's the lowest point in North America.
